summary: Pay-per-check AI crawler visibility audit over x402 (USDC on Base): plain no-JavaScript fetch with findings, free public catalog for passes.
description: HTTP API and remote MCP that audit whether AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, OAI-SearchBot style) can see a site without JavaScript. Documented packs (llms.txt / free manifest 2026-11-09): one check $0.01; catalog snapshot $0.005; free registry JSON at /registry.json and free submit queue. A GET without payment returns HTTP 402 (x402 v2) — verified on /buy/one without signing. MCP at https://402registry.com/mcp exposes free tools get_pricing, get_docs, get_service_status plus paid lookup_site. OpenAPI and terms verified 200. Vendor-affiliated (#33, paranormalen2). Shared operator with AISkills402, 402cron and 402post. Real USDC payments; verification used free discovery and 402 challenges only. Passing checks may publish a public listing — treat that as intentional disclosure.

agent_access.notes: x402 USDC on Base; free registry.json, docs, pricing tools. Paid checks require payment signature (not used during verification).
